## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the affected checks and their results.

- [ ] Affected contract text is updated in the same commit.
- [ ] Regression coverage verifies the public behavior.
- [ ] No assertions, budgets, timeouts, or security gates were weakened.
- [ ] No silent skips or `continue-on-error` were added.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, or private data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and both READMEs match the implementation.
